name: Kanachi (Armenian Herb Salad)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Remove extra stem endings, yellow leaves, and damaged parts from all herbs and wash them thoroughly. Drain.
Remove roots from green onions and radishes and majority of radish leaves (leaving only the younger ones). Wash them thoroughly and drain.
Mix them up or arrange them on a plate.

culture.text: Sabzi khordan, kanachi, goy, or pinjar is a common side dish in Iranian, Armenian, Azerbaijani and Kurdish cuisines, which may be served with any meal, consisting of any combination of a set of fresh herbs and raw vegetables. Basil or purple basil, mint, parsley, tarragon, coriander, leek and radishes are among the most common ones.
